elements.title: Grizel Niven (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Grizel Niven created "The Bessie", the Women's Prize for Fiction statuette, which a past winner called "ugly"?

elements.title: Western Air Lines Flight 636 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that two of the victims and much of the aircraft involved in the crash of Western Air Lines Flight 636 were never removed from San Francisco Bay?

elements.title: a superintendent of the New Orleans Police Department (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a superintendent of the New Orleans Police Department posed as a corrupt officer during covert operations?

elements.title: The Lock-Up (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that The Lock-Up, an art gallery housed in a former police station, retains the graffiti drawn by prisoners in the holding cells and has incorporated it into a performative exhibition?
